## Fixes
- **Posters with Radarr/Sonarr login enabled** – when Radarr or Sonarr require a login, their `/MediaCover/` images redirect to the login page even with the API key, so posters and library backgrounds failed (*redirected to login (302) – authentication is enabled*). This was hidden before because ArrHub fell back to TMDB/TVDB; in offline mode it showed. ArrHub now loads them through `/api/v3/mediacover/…`, which accepts the API key, and keeps the old path as a fallback.
- **Quieter log** – failing images are logged once per service instead of once per image.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.11.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.11.0...v1.11.1
